ux_intent: Validate that the caption toggle is discoverable in the main control bar — not buried in a submenu — and that position and duration text remains legible against video frames via a scrim, not against the unpredictable video content itself.
figma_make_prompt:
Build a video player screen for the Hoopla digital library app.

Platform: mobile (iOS and Android), 390x844 base frame.
Full-screen video. No top app bar. A semi-transparent dark scrim (rgba 0,0,0,0.55) overlays the bottom 40 % of the frame when controls are visible.

Layout (controls overlay, bottom-aligned on the scrim):
- Video title at the top of the scrim area (Body Medium, 16sp, #FFFFFF).
- Seekbar: full-width minus 16px padding on each side. Thumb 18dp diameter, #FFFFFF. Elapsed portion primary #6366F1, remaining portion #4B5563. Current position left (Body Small, 14sp, #FFFFFF), total duration right. Touch-target height 48dp.
- Control row: horizontal, evenly spaced, centred. Six buttons, each 48x48dp touch target, icons #FFFFFF:
  - Back arrow (exit player)
  - Rewind 10s
  - Play / Pause (56x56dp touch target, primary #6366F1 filled circle)
  - Fast-forward 10s
  - Caption toggle ("CC" icon — highlighted with primary fill when captions are on, default #FFFFFF outline when off)
  - Three-dot menu
- A close button (X) in the top-right corner, 48x48dp touch target.

States:
- Playing, controls hidden: full-screen video only. No overlay.
- Playing, controls visible: scrim rendered, all controls shown, Play icon is Pause.
- Paused: controls always visible. Pause icon is Play.
- Captions on: CC button has primary #6366F1 filled background. White caption text renders over the video inside dark semi-transparent boxes (padding 4px, radius 2px, background rgba 0,0,0,0.7).
- Captions off: CC button is #FFFFFF outline only. No subtitle boxes on screen.
- Error: controls hidden. Centred on screen: error icon + "Playback error" (Body Medium, 18sp, #FFFFFF) + "Retry" button (primary filled, 160x56dp).

Behavior:
- Tap video area (when controls are hidden) → show controls; auto-hide after 3 seconds of inactivity.
- Tap Play/Pause → toggle state.
- Tap CC → toggle captions; button highlight updates immediately.
- Tap three-dot menu → bottom sheet: audio track selection, playback speed.

Style:
- Dark, full-bleed. Scrim rgba(0,0,0,0.55). Text on scrim #FFFFFF full opacity. Primary #6366F1 for active states. Subtitle boxes rgba(0,0,0,0.7). Auto layout.

First step: controls-visible state in paused mode with all six buttons rendered, seekbar with labels, and the CC button in its off (outline) state.
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given the video player controls are visible
When the user scans the control row
Then the caption toggle (CC icon) is present in the same row as Play/Pause — not inside the three-dot menu

Given captions are toggled on
When subtitles are displayed over the video
Then each subtitle line is white text inside a dark semi-transparent box, legible regardless of what the video shows behind it

Given the controls are visible
When position and duration labels are checked for contrast
Then they meet ≥ 4.5:1 against the scrim colour, not against the raw video frame

Given the player encounters an error
When the error state is rendered
Then a retry button is centred on screen and the scrim and controls are hidden
manual_validation_checklist: Confirm the CC button is in the main control row, same row as Play/Pause
Verify caption subtitle styling: white text, dark semi-transparent box (rgba 0,0,0,0.7), text ≥ 14sp
Check position/duration label contrast against the scrim (not the video): white on rgba(0,0,0,0.55) exceeds 4.5:1
Confirm scrim covers exactly the bottom 40 % of the frame and all controls sit within it
Verify error state centres its content and the Retry button is ≥ 48dp touch target
